h1: Photo Booth Hire Guildford for Weddings, Proms and Parties
intro: Guildford keeps a busy social calendar, with country house weddings in the Surrey Hills, student balls, school proms and big family birthdays all within a few miles of the town centre. Our photo booth hire Guildford packages start from £239 and bring a professional attendant, delivery, setup, props and a personalised print template, so the planning stays simple.

sections.heading: Event advice for Guildford hosts and planners
paragraphs: Country weddings in and around Guildford usually follow a long afternoon of photographs on the lawn, so the booth tends to come into its own once the evening guests arrive. Opening it after the first dance gives a lively queue without competing with the speeches. Couples looking for a wedding photo booth Guildford guests will remember can ask for a template matched to their stationery, and every print booth comes with a guest book for the strips and messages.

University events in the town range from society socials to end-of-year balls and graduation celebrations, and they reward quick sharing: digital copies by email or QR code mean students can post the results before the night is over. School proms need early booking for June and July, milestone birthdays suit themed props, corporate clients want a logo on every print, and Christmas parties benefit from a festive overlay and a booking made by early autumn.

sections.heading: From Merrow and Burpham out to Shalford and Bramley
paragraphs: Guildford is the county town of Surrey, and our work here reaches well beyond the centre. Merrow and Burpham on the eastern side are home to many of the family parties we cover, Stoughton sits to the north, and Shalford and Bramley lie to the south along the A281. Godalming and Woking are close neighbours, and the Surrey Hills stretch away to the south and east with their scattered country venues.

The A3 is the spine of most journeys, running through the town and meeting the M25 at junction 10. The A31 heads west, the A25 runs east towards the Hills and the A281 carries us south, so every corner of the area is within easy reach. Guildford is one stop on our broader photo booth hire Surrey route, and delivery and setup are part of every package rather than an added extra.

sections.heading: Booths that suit the Guildford calendar
paragraphs: The Magic Mirror leads the way for country house hotel weddings. It stands as a full-length mirror with on-screen animations and games, a DSLR camera and a print for every guest, and it fits up to eight people per shot. Anyone comparing options for magic mirror hire in Guildford should allow around two metres square of floor space and a little over two metres of headroom.

For large student balls and big birthday parties, the Inflatable Booth glows in a colour chosen to match the theme and takes up to ten guests at a time, given a 4-metre square floor and three metres of ceiling. The GIF Booth suits corporate and university events that are social-first, with animated overlays and instant email or QR delivery. The LCD SlimPod remains the best-value option for proms and village hall parties, with prints, GIFs and smart background removal in a slim, easily placed pod.

sections.heading: Country house hotels, Surrey Hills barns and halls
paragraphs: Country house hotels around Guildford host many of the area's weddings, anniversaries and formal dinners, usually with a choice of reception rooms and well-kept grounds. Converted barns in the Surrey Hills offer a more relaxed setting, often with high timber ceilings that leave plenty of room for even the taller booths. Golf clubs on the edge of town are a frequent choice for birthdays, charity evenings and seasonal parties.

University venues provide halls and function rooms for balls, society dinners and graduation gatherings, while village halls in the surrounding parishes and school halls in and around Guildford cover christenings, proms and community fundraisers. Each type of venue has its own rhythm, and sharing the room layout and timings when you enquire lets us place the booth where it will be used most.

sections.heading: Arrival, access and setup on the day
paragraphs: Surrey Hills venues are often reached along narrow rural lanes and finished with a long gravel drive, which slows a loaded trolley, so we build in extra time and agree the unloading point with the venue beforehand. Town-centre and university venues can have limited parking or a timed loading slot, and we work to whichever arrangement applies. If the function room is upstairs, a lift helps, though the slimmer booths are easily carried up stairs.

Our setup takes 45 to 60 minutes and is completed before the hire window starts, at no charge. One standard socket powers each booth, with two needed for the Inflatable Booth. Marquee receptions in hotel gardens or on barn lawns need a reliable 13A socket within a few metres, and if a generator supplies the tent, its provider should confirm spare capacity for the booth.

faqs.q: Where do you unload at a country house hotel or Surrey Hills barn?
faqs.a: We agree the unloading point with the venue in advance, which is often a service entrance or the yard nearest the reception room. Gravel drives take a little longer with trolleys, so we allow for that, then move the van to the car park or wherever the venue asks suppliers to park.

faqs.q: Can a booth be taken up stairs at a university or upper-floor venue?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as we know beforehand. The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth and Retro Pod carry up stairs comfortably. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth are best placed on the ground floor or reached by lift, so please share the route from the entrance to the room when you book.

faqs.q: Will we pay extra for travel to a venue near Guildford?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included in every package, and Guildford, Godalming, Woking and the nearby villages fall within our usual area. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so the figure you approve is the figure you pay.

faqs.q: The A3 can be slow on a Friday evening. Will the booth be ready on time?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan the journey around the time of day and the usual delays on the A3 and around junction 10 of the M25, then add the 45 to 60 minute setup on top. If the venue sets a supplier arrival slot, tell us when booking and we will aim for it.

faqs.q: Is the Inflatable Booth practical for a Guildford venue?
faqs.a: It suits barns, ballrooms and large function halls well. It needs a floor area of about four metres square, a ceiling of at least three metres and two standard sockets. Low-ceilinged rooms are better served by the Magic Mirror or LCD SlimPod, and we can help you compare.

faqs.q: How do we reserve a date for a ball or a wedding?
faqs.a: An £80 deposit secures the date, and the balance is due one month before the event. Summer weekends, graduation season and December are the busiest periods around Guildford, so organisers of balls, weddings and Christmas parties usually confirm several months ahead.
